From Magician's Red · Price: full power needs the target in your stand's line of sight within 30 ft.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: fire ankh at a creature within 30 ft that your stand can see: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[fire]], @Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}. You also sense fire and heat within 30 ft (imprecise).
  • 5: Surge, 2 actions: @Template[cone|distance:15]{15-ft cone} of @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 9: Burning binding: on a critical failure against the ankh, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} by flame ropes for 1 round.
  • 13: Surge: 6 flame ankhs that seek up to 6 targets within 30 ft: each takes @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 17: @Damage[2d6[persistent,fire]] on any failed save.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
